meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw 会把你的个人微信当通道用：手机扫码后，微信号变成机器人，收到的微信消息由智能体（agent）阅读并回复。
howto.when: 当你想在 NanoClaw 里让智能体收发个人微信消息时。需要先扫码登录，并把收到的消息接到一个 agent 组，之后才会开始回复。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加微信渠道并扫码登录。
say.note: 会复制适配器并提示你打开二维码用手机扫描。

say.text: 把收到的微信消息接到一个 agent 组，陌生人需批准。
say.note: 运行接线脚本，新联系人需管理员批准后才能对话。

say.text: 微信会话过期了，帮我重新登录。
say.note: 删除认证文件并重启服务，再扫码即可。

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw uses your personal WeChat as a channel: after QR scan, the WeChat account acts as a bot and incoming messages are read and replied to by the agent.
howto.when_en: Use when you want the agent in NanoClaw to send and receive personal WeChat messages. Requires QR login and wiring inbound messages to an agent group before replies start.

say_en.text: Add a WeChat channel to NanoClaw and scan the QR to log in.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and prompts QR scan on your phone.

say_en.text: Wire incoming WeChat messages to an agent group with approval for strangers.
say_en.note: Uses approval policy; new contacts need admin approval.

say_en.text: My WeChat session expired; help me re-login.
say_en.note: Deletes auth.json, restarts, then prompts re-scan.
